rounds.title: Skeleton baseline
rounds.note: First drawing of the SDK skeleton (et-skeleton), drawn by its mock from @ethlete/components/design on the page: bones filled with --et-surface-interaction-solid at 12% over the page, 4px radius, 8px gap, text bones 0.85em in a 1.4em line, round circles; the shimmer (the same token at 16% in a 90deg gradient, 1400ms) is held still at the middle of its sweep. States: the story card, three text lines, the bare shapes, a bare text bone inside a sentence (no shimmer, as in the story) and the card without the shimmer (animated off, also what reduced motion shows). Q98, numbers only: the fill is 1.16:1 against the page light, 1.22:1 dark; the shimmer peak is 1.22:1 against the fill light, 1.32:1 dark (1.41 / 1.60 against the page). In light the shimmer is a darker band, not a highlight, because the interaction token is dark there. A skeleton is not interactive and carries no text, so 1.4.11 does not ask 3:1 of it; the visually hidden status label is the announcement. No decided rule applies: the skeleton has no focus ring (Q88), no mint (Q99) and no edge, so no variant b and no Q102. Variant a alone shows today.

a.note: Today, alone in this round: no decided rule applies (no focus ring, no mint, no edge). Q98 open: fill 1.16:1 / 1.22:1 against the page, shimmer peak 1.22:1 / 1.32:1 against the fill, light / dark; in light the shimmer darkens the bone.
